description: Every total computable function \(f:\mathbb N^k\to\mathbb N\), including zero input arity, has a single arithmetic formula \(F\) such that, for every numerical tuple \(\bar a\), \(Q\vdash\forall y\,(F(\overline{\bar a},y)\leftrightarrow y=\overline{f(\bar a)})\).
signature:
